moneyFlow.title: Enter the LT pool
moneyFlow.text: Deposit WETH and receive LT shares. The receipt represents net pool equity after its crvUSD liability.

moneyFlow.title: Borrow the dollar leg
moneyFlow.text: The pool borrows crvUSD to supply both sides of WETH/crvUSD liquidity. Actual debt at T is 27,814,855.84 crvUSD, separate from the 64.14M allocation limit.

moneyFlow.title: Maintain ETH exposure
moneyFlow.text: The design uses roughly 2x gross liquidity versus equity. Automated debt adjustment seeks to keep the net payoff tied to WETH as the ETH price moves.

moneyFlow.title: Earn trading fees
moneyFlow.text: Swaps pay liquidity-provider fees. Financing, rebalancing and administration consume part of that income. A high gross LP yield is not a net ETH return.

moneyFlow.title: Choose whether to stake
moneyFlow.text: Staking LT shares in the gauge changes the fee-allocation and reward rights. At T, 5,875 ETH of net book is staked and 4,551 ETH is unstaked. These sum to one pool.

moneyFlow.title: Apply the fee mechanism
moneyFlow.text: The minimum admin parameter is 10%. Actual fee allocation varies through the contract mechanism; it is not a flat 10% deduction from every holder’s gain.

moneyFlow.title: Mark the investor claim
moneyFlow.text: Use updated effective supply and fair ETH value per LT unit. The unstaked mark fell 0.69% over 94 days while stETH gained 0.57%; this excludes external gauge rewards.

moneyFlow.title: Unwind and repay
moneyFlow.text: Withdrawal removes liquidity, settles the crvUSD loan and releases WETH. The snapshot previews quote 104, 1,043 and 3,128 WETH for 1%, 10% and 30% of raw supply; no paid exit is established by a preview.

moneyFlow.title: Deposit WETH
moneyFlow.text: PlasmaVault issues 20-decimal shares and accounts in 18-decimal WETH.

moneyFlow.title: Post wstETH collateral on Ebisu at T
moneyFlow.text: The active Ebisu Trove contains 4,585.482153 wstETH. The product name and earlier description refer to Liquity, but active fuses and loan getters identify Ebisu.

moneyFlow.title: Borrow ebUSD
moneyFlow.text: Accrued debt is 6,752,064.750858 ebUSD with a 2.55% annual borrower-set rate. Upfront fees and rate-adjustment fees can add to financing cost.

moneyFlow.title: Stablecoin and liquidity positions
moneyFlow.text: Granted market substrates include ebUSD and USDC. Active market 53 uses Uniswap V4; its recorded book assets are separate from the borrowing-account equity. The earlier BOLD/Curve description is not proof of the active T route.

moneyFlow.title: Look through the held LP
moneyFlow.text: The held Curve gauge maps to ebUSD/USDC despite its legacy BOLDUSDC symbol. Its LP principal is reconstructed separately from the stored Uniswap V4 book; the symbol is not the debt asset.

moneyFlow.title: Identify what pays
moneyFlow.text: Stablecoin swaps fund trading fees. Incentives require a funded campaign, actual payout and realization into the debt or accounting asset. An advertised LP rate is not net ETH carry income.

moneyFlow.title: Charge the outer fees
moneyFlow.text: Fixed-block settings are 0.5% annual management and 10% performance. Borrower-set interest is not the entire financing cost: opening and rate-adjustment charges also matter.

moneyFlow.title: Reduce liquidity and repay ebUSD
moneyFlow.text: An exit must unwind LP inventory, obtain ebUSD and repay the Trove before the wstETH collateral is released. Stablecoin discounts and thin LP liquidity can make this costly.

moneyFlow.title: Pay the investor
moneyFlow.text: At T, the 1% book-demand withdrawal call succeeds while 10% and 30% fail. These are snapshot calls, separate from the receipt-verified historical payouts in the exit study.

moneyFlow.title: Deposit wstETH
moneyFlow.text: The ConcreteAsyncVault share token issues roywstETH.

moneyFlow.title: Strategy adapter
moneyFlow.text: The RoycoVaultMakinaStrategy adapter reports allocated value to the share vault.

moneyFlow.title: Makina machine and Caliber
moneyFlow.text: The adapter allocates into the configured Makina machine, which uses a Caliber executor to hold positions. Three recorded position values are stale at T.

moneyFlow.title: Borrow PYUSD at T
moneyFlow.text: Actual Caliber instructions identify the Morpho wstETH/PYUSD market. Funding into the USDC-denominated senior receipt requires a separate currency-conversion trace.

moneyFlow.title: Invest in Senior tranches
moneyFlow.text: Borrowed dollars buy srRoyUSDC, which allocates only to Senior tranches. Junior capital provides finite first-loss coverage.

moneyFlow.title: Match the borrowing and investment currencies
moneyFlow.text: The actual loan owes PYUSD, while the senior investment is USDC-denominated. Holdings alone do not trace every borrowed unit through a conversion into that receipt.

moneyFlow.title: Read the senior cash rights
moneyFlow.text: Junior capital absorbs a finite first-loss amount in the published design. That protection does not eliminate underlying credit loss, currency mismatch or redemption timing.

moneyFlow.title: Separate fresh balances from stale marks
moneyFlow.text: Fresh collateral, accrued debt and senior receipt balances are measured at T. Three parent position values are stale; their cached sum cannot substitute for a freshly reconciled book.

moneyFlow.title: Process the asynchronous exit
moneyFlow.text: Immediate maxWithdraw is zero at T. Investment redemption, PYUSD repayment and share-queue fulfillment must be coordinated. A request or preview does not establish a paid withdrawal.
